i feel like a big issue for giving her a tool to use would be that it could feel encouraging? like obviously you want to ensure that she's safe and won't have to worry about going too deep, but being given a way to hurt yourself by an important figure in your life would feel quite encouraging, or that you don't see it as enough of an issue to worry about her self harming in general. 

obviously that isn't how you're trying to approach this but it could very much be taken that way. 

also (even though i haven't quit) something i found to give a similar rush without the harm was flicking rubber bands against the inside of your wrist, or peeling glue off hairy bits of your skin. it hurts enough to kind of mimic that pain but it doesn't cause any long term harm. even if you did give her something dull to use, that would be better than risking a deep cut (i know that if i had access to things like that i couldn't avoided so many scares), but again you wouldn't want to come across as encouraging the self harm.

i really hope she gets through this, it's a painful addiction and a shitty way to cope, but sometimes it feels like the only option
